subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers that reject `role: "system"`, should OpenClaw treat existing `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` as the supported fix, sponsor an opt-in top-level `instructions` compatibility mode, or change the default role policy?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe product behavior differs across OpenAI-compatible provider families and may create or document a public config contract.

options.title: Document existing compat
options.body: Keep current defaults and route this exact developer-vs-system case to `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true`, with docs/tests if coverage is missing.

options.title: Sponsor instructions placement
options.body: Accept the new config surface from the open candidate PR for stricter relays that reject prompt messages inside Responses `input`.

options.title: Change default role policy
options.body: Make reasoning custom Responses models send `developer` by default, accepting regression risk for providers that reject that role.

recommendation.title: Document existing compat
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and route this exact developer-vs-system case to `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true`, with docs/tests if coverage is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current developer-role compatibility behavior and the relevant regression coverage.
